text: Bitcoin's modest 1.9% decline is holding near $82k while Ethereum and altcoins are selling off more sharply—ETH down 3.9%, smaller caps down 5%+—suggesting a flight to safety within crypto. Despite the pullback, the Fear & Greed Index remains in greed territory at 64, though it's weakened 10 points over the week, indicating confidence is cooling without panic. Bitcoin's dominance at 59% and elevated 24h volume of $677B reflect rotational pressure rather than capitulation, as traders appear to be trimming risk exposure across the board.
